title: China Launches 24th Batch of Low-Orbit Internet Satellites

blocks.content: China launched the 24th batch of low-Earth orbit internet satellites on 16 August 2026 from the Wenchang Space Launch Site in Hainan Province, southern China. The satellites, identified as SatNet LEO Group 24, were carried by a Long March-12 carrier rocket during its Y8 mission and entered their preset orbits after launch at 12:10 p.m. Beijing Time, or 04:10 UTC.

items: Low-Earth orbit is commonly used for communication satellites because it supports lower signal delay than higher orbits.
The geostationary orbit lies at about 35,786 km above Earth’s equator.
China’s Long March series is the country’s main family of orbital launch vehicles.
Hainan is a southern Chinese island province with commercial launch facilities near the equator.
